name: Novelty effect
description: Эффект на днях 1-2 vs 3+. Сильное расхождение — фича работает только из-за новизны.

source:
## 4. Novelty effect

Если эффект на первых двух днях заметно отличается от дней 3+, фича может работать только за счёт новизны. На коротких тестах novelty часто прячет «настоящий» эффект.

metric_col = '{{metric_column}}'
early = df[df['day'] <= 2]
later = df[df['day'] >= 3]

def lift(part):
    means = part.groupby('variant')[metric_col].mean()
    if 'control' not in means or 'treatment' not in means or means['control'] == 0:
        return None
    return (means['treatment'] - means['control']) / means['control']

lift_early = lift(early)
lift_later = lift(later)

print(f'lift days 1-2: {lift_early:.3%}' if lift_early is not None else 'lift days 1-2: n/a')
print(f'lift days 3+:  {lift_later:.3%}' if lift_later is not None else 'lift days 3+: n/a')

if lift_early is not None and lift_later is not None and abs(lift_early - lift_later) > 0.5 * abs(lift_later or 1):
    print('NOVELTY suspected — early lift differs by >50% relative from later days')
